utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Just to be safe, let's double-check the times before heading over—Cleo said Saturday, but that flyer was from last week.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good idea, Pia. Let me check the flyer again to make sure it's still valid.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly—I just don't want us to show up at the wrong time or find out they moved it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: So, you all set for Saturday? Got your own gear, or do you need me to bring my wrenches along?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got my own set. Just be there at 9 with whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, I'll be there with my toolbox just in case. See you at 9.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Vik, have you heard about the repair drive? They're still taking broken electronics at the community center, and Mara's got folks ready to fix them up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I've been telling everyone about it! I'm bringing my old lamp to get fixed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Vik! Mara told me they're still accepting small appliances and electronics, so your lamp should be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Uli, glad you're here! I'm just checking my supply list—do we have enough tarps and nails for the roof patch-up this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure about the supplies, Cleo. I'll just be there for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that's okay, Uli! Even a little help goes a long way—could you maybe grab a few extra tarps from the storage shed before you head out?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo! Have you heard about the repair drive going on at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that thing? I'm not sure of the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's really cool — Opal's got bins set up in the basement, and people are dropping off old tools and furniture to fix up. Want me to fill you in?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, what's this about a repair drive? I haven't heard much about it yet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not entirely sure myself. I've heard different things—some say roof repairs, others say small appliances. I'd like to find out more before signing up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I keep hearing bits and pieces too. Have you talked to anyone who actually knows the details?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, just wanted to remind you the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center. Need any help setting up?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday? That's a change from the original plan, but I'll adjust. I've got my tools, but we should make sure everyone knows their role. Could you help me sort out a schedule?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help with that. Let's grab a coffee and map out who's doing what.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Faye, sorry I'm late—did you catch that the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday? Oh, I thought it was still up in the air—good to know, thanks Dane.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, it's all set now. I heard the alignment was giving trouble, but they figured it out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal! So glad I ran into you. You haven't forgotten about the repair drive this Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course not, Quinn — I've got it marked on my calendar. Community center, 9 a.m., right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect! I knew I could count on you. It's going to be such a productive and fun morning!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm planning to bring my wobbly table, Noah. You have anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh yeah, the repair drive—this Saturday, at the community center, right? I think I have an old lamp that flickers somewhere... maybe I'll dig it up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That lamp sounds like a perfect project! I heard they've got some real handy folks coming, so it should be a good time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina, are we still on for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I'm planning to be there. Have you talked to anyone else about helping out?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I asked Quinn and Opal earlier — they both said they'd come Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive this Saturday? Where'd you hear that from? I haven't seen any flyers or emails about it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I thought Vik mentioned it at the community center... or was that about the potluck? I get those mixed up sometimes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so you're not even sure it's happening? I don't want to show up for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh hey Rosa! Have you heard about the repair drive at the community center? They're still collecting small electronics and appliances, and I heard Mara's got folks ready to fix 'em up!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Tess, I just wanted to let you know the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center — still happening, just a different day and spot!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the heads-up, Rosa! I'll make sure to tell Pia and Uli about the change.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, you seem to know the most about this repair drive—what's your honest opinion on it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Mina, I wish I could help, but I'm a bit fuzzy on the details. I think it's about fixing up old appliances like toasters, but you might want to ask someone else for the full scoop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought you were the one spreading the word about it. Vik mentioned bikes and mowers at the community center next Saturday—did you hear something different?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait—this Saturday? I thought it was next weekend. Are we sure about the timing? I don't want to show up with my old blender to an empty hall.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's this Saturday, Pia. Noah confirmed it too — I've got my wrenches ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, if you're sure about Saturday, I'll bring my blender. But can we double-check the start time? I don't want to be the only one there at 8 AM.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Ira, have you heard how many folks signed up to help at the community center? I'm getting a bit worried about the roof crew.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm not sure about the numbers, but I heard there's a repair drive this Saturday at the community center—might get some hands for the roof there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that's the repair drive I've been prepping my toolbox for! I'll be there Saturday — hopefully we can wrangle enough people to tackle that roof.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara! Did you hear about the repair drive Opal's organizing? They've set up bins in the community center basement.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I'd love to help! Let me know what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great, Mara! I think they're collecting tools and donations—maybe you could spread the word to some of your friends too?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Noah, just a heads up — the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. Need any help setting up?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday. Did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, it changed — sorry for the short notice. I can come early Sunday to help you shift any gear if you need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I'm late—so the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, it's still Saturday for sure—are you mixing it up with something else?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Really? I heard from Jules and Hana that it got changed to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Rey, what exactly is this repair drive supposed to be for? I'm a bit confused about its purpose.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I thought it was for small appliances, but Rosa said it's actually for the community center roof. I'm still a bit confused myself.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, the roof? That doesn’t match what I heard about it needing special calibration for electronics.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So, Faye, did you check that flyer? Is it next week or the week after?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm not sure, Bo. I haven't seen anything official yet—it could be either week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Huh, I guess neither of us knows for sure then. I'll just pencil in next week and hope for the best.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I'd need to see that flyer myself before I believe it. Where exactly was it posted?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I saw it up on the bulletin board outside the corner store — bright yellow, you can't miss it!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, I'll take a look next time I'm passing by. But I'm still not convinced until I see it with my own eyes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh Gus was just mentioning tools for something called a repair drive. Do you know what that's all about? I'm still catching up on the neighborhood news.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it's a community thing this weekend — folks are fixing up broken stuff together. I'll be there for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wonderful! What kind of things are people fixing up? I'd love to help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, don't forget the repair drive this Saturday at the community center! Bring that chair you mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, Vik. I'll bring the chair. Starts at 9, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's right, 9 AM sharp! I'll see you there with my old lamp.
